text: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
explanation: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee. Dr. Rajendra Prasad was President of the Constituent Assembly.

text: On which date did the Constitution of India come into force?
explanation: It came into force on 26 January 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day. It was adopted on 26 November 1949.

text: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
explanation: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

text: What is the minimum age to be a member of the Lok Sabha?
explanation: A candidate for the Lok Sabha must be at least 25 years old. For the Rajya Sabha it is 30.

text: The Right to Education for children aged 6 to 14 is provided under which Article?
explanation: Article 21A, added by the 86th Amendment, makes education a fundamental right for children aged 6 to 14.

text: The Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution by which Amendment?
explanation: The 42nd Amendment of 1976 added the Fundamental Duties in Part IVA, Article 51A.

text: Who is regarded as the father of modern economics?
explanation: Adam Smith, author of The Wealth of Nations, is usually called the father of modern economics.

text: The financial year in India runs from:
explanation: India's financial year starts on 1 April and ends on 31 March.

text: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) was rolled out in India on:
explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

text: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
explanation: The RBI's headquarters is in Mumbai.

text: The repo rate is the rate at which:
options: The RBI lends short-term money to commercial banks
The government borrows from the RBI
explanation: The repo rate is the rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks.

text: The Planning Commission was replaced in 2015 by:
explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission on 1 January 2015.

text: The First Five Year Plan of India was launched in which year?
explanation: The First Five Year Plan ran from 1951 to 1956.
